name: Glass book
description: A translucent open book turns slowly in space. Where its pages overlap, the glass deepens, like a glenz object from a nineties demo.
choices: The rotating glenz solid becomes a six-leaf open book with a tan ribbon, projected in true perspective
Translucent navy faces deepen where they overlap on light pages; on dark pages they brighten like glass
motion: The book turns once every sixteen seconds and two small glints pulse; the static file holds a three-quarter view.
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
